citations.claim: NS direction green just before emergency
NS enters yellow at 65, lasting only 1s before forced green
EW turns green at 66 with 0s all-red, need 4s

counterfactual.change: Removed emergency event at t=66. Without preemption, controller respects yellow_seconds=6 and all_red_seconds=4.

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=66 during NS yellow immediately forces EW green at step 66, skipping the all-red clearance interval. NS was green at step 64, yellow at 65 (only 1s of yellow instead of required 6s), then EW green at 66 with 0s all-red (need 4s). This violates all_red_clearance and also yellow_duration. Removing the emergency restores normal sequencing.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 4 s)

vision_note: Steps 63-64 show NS green with EW red, and step 65 shows NS yellow. At step 66 the lights flip directly to EW green with NS red, with no intervening frame where all four approaches are red and with yellow lasting only one frame.
